clue.text: The same egg consumption applied to school spread? I suspect not

parts.note: DO is the short form of ditto, meaning the same again

indicators.note: the egg is stretched out so that it extends around the pieces that follow

parts.note: a nit is the egg of a louse

indicators.note: one piece is placed straight against the next, so the illness sits right before the school

parts.note: TB, tuberculosis, was once called consumption
Eton is the famous English public school

explanation.surface: A sceptic doubts that a ditto order of eggs could be shared across a whole school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spread' stretches the egg so that the illness and the school sit inside it; 'applied to' just joins those two.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are idiomatic expressions of doubt that something will happen, the wager phrase meaning I would not gamble on it.

clue.text: A question of note? Dreadful fuss over "Old Glory" White House budget compensation …

indicators.note: dreadful suggests something in a terrible mess, so the following letters are jumbled

parts.words: fuss over "Old Glory" White House budget compensation
parts.note: taken as written, forty-four letters of fodder

explanation.surface: A headline about an awful row over flag and presidential spending, posed like a question.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram covers the whole run from 'fuss' to 'compensation'; Old Glory is the US flag. The song title continues at 2 down, whose clue picks up from 'over'.
explanation.definitionFit: The title is a 1959 novelty song by Lonnie Donegan, and as a title it is phrased as a question, hence a question set to music.

indicators.note: darned as in mended, stitched over, hints that the following word gets reworked into new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: The tail of an exasperated cry about some annoying object.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis continues the 1 down song: its title ends with 'over' plus this word, so 'over this' is the definition. 'darned' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The song's title finishes with the time word overnight, so the word placed after over in the lyric is this one.

clue.text: I'll help to tell your fortune for a nicker

definitions.text: I'll help to tell your fortune
definitions.meaning: fortune-tellers read the leftover leaves in a teacup
one who nicks, a thief; Cockney rhyming slang for thief

explanation.walkthrough: Cockney rhyming slang is a London habit of replacing a word with a phrase that rhymes with it: tea leaf for thief.
explanation.definitionFit: Reading tea dregs is a fortune-telling method, and in rhyming slang the same phrase means a thief, someone who nicks things.

clue.text: Someone else's loan negotiation, in theory?

parts.note: someone else is not I, not me

indicators.note: a negotiation works terms around, so the following word's letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Wondering whether someone else's loan talks could exist only on paper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Someone else' is anyone who is not me; 'negotiation' is the anagram signal on the loan.
explanation.definitionFit: Something notional exists only as an idea, as opposed to in practice, so it is hypothetical.

parts.note: read literally, someone walking high up on a strung cable rather than a nervous person on foot

explanation.walkthrough: Highly-strung normally means nervous; here it means walking on a line strung high in the air.
explanation.definitionFit: A circus performer crosses a cable stretched high above the ground, literally walking while highly strung.

parts.note: 24 across is silly, and a silly person is a jerk
wearing clothes means being in them

explanation.surface: Someone foolish dressed in a jacket.
explanation.definitionFit: A jerkin is a close-fitting sleeveless jacket, historically of leather.

definitions.meaning: to be wearing kit or clothes

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both clothed in one's kit and, of a vehicle, with a gear engaged and able to move.

clue.text: Taunt Frenchman about some living matter

indicators.note: about signals turning round, so the taunt and the Frenchman are read backwards together

parts.note: a dig is a taunting remark
Rene is a typical French man's name

explanation.surface: Someone mocks a French person over a biological sample.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns the whole of DIG RENE, giving ENER GID.
explanation.definitionFit: An energid is a biology term for a nucleus with its surrounding cytoplasm, a unit of living protoplasm.

clue.text: Get in a muddle and name one to activate the defences

indicators.note: in a muddle means jumbled, so the preceding letters are mixed up

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone flustered names a person to put the defences on alert.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'a' of 'in a muddle' is part of the fodder GETINA.
explanation.definitionFit: An antigen is a substance that triggers the body's immune response, so it sets off the defences.

clue.text: A letter may result from this operation relating to my depression

definitions.text: A letter may result from this operation relating to my depression

parts.words: A letter may result from this operation relating to my depression
parts.note: read as a typist speaking: a character appears when one presses a button down

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a medical letter about depression; the depression is a pressing of a key.
explanation.definitionFit: Pressing a single button on a keyboard produces a letter on screen, an action of pushing down.

parts.note: no is a word of negation
US is the abbreviation for the United States

explanation.surface: A jibe that common sense is lacking in the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: Nous is British informal for practical intelligence or gumption.

clue.text: One led on by convoluted strategy for attack

indicators.note: convoluted means twisted, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
taken as written

explanation.surface: A single person is lured by a tangled plan of assault.
explanation.walkthrough: Bodyline was the English bowling tactic in the 1932-33 cricket Ashes series, aiming fast balls at the batsman's body.
explanation.definitionFit: It was a deliberate plan of attacking bowling, so it is a strategy for attack in cricket.

clue.text: Strong-scented plant chopped up by German cook

indicators.note: chopped up like ingredients, so the following letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A fragrant herb is diced by a German chef.
explanation.definitionFit: Mock orange, or philadelphus, is a shrub with intensely fragrant white flowers.

indicators.note: to describe a circle is to draw round, so mad goes around the woman

parts.note: frenzied means mad
Ena is a woman's name

explanation.surface: Asking what kind of woman the word frenzied describes.
explanation.walkthrough: Ena is a classic crossword woman, from Ena Sharples of the British TV soap Coronation Street; 'describes' means drawing round her.
explanation.definitionFit: A maenad was a frenzied female follower of Bacchus, so the whole clue describes her.

indicators.note: in a down clue on places the first piece above the second

parts.note: a do is a deed, an act
an aeon is a long period of time

explanation.surface: A stag party is running on schedule.
explanation.walkthrough: Stag looks like stag do; Actaeon was the hunter turned into a stag by Artemis.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Actaeon was transformed into a stag, so the mythological figure is defined by the animal.

definitions.meaning: making a hash of something is making a muddle of it

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a forces dining room and a muddle or botched job.

clue.text: Vision producing order at Wimbledon departs from Centre

indicators.note: leaves from the centre, so the letter goes from the middle of the word

parts.note: tennis seeding is the ranked order of top players at the Wimbledon tournament
D is the timetable abbreviation for departs

explanation.surface: Seeing the tennis draw being made as players leave Centre Court.
explanation.walkthrough: Centre Court is Wimbledon's main court; here 'Centre' means the middle of SEEDING, its fourth letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Seeing is the faculty of sight, which is what vision means.

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy
a Very light is a signal flare fired from a pistol

explanation.surface: All power is given over to illumination.
explanation.definitionFit: Every and all both quantify the whole of a group.

parts.note: by means multiplied by, as in three by four, so times
William Hare was one of the Edinburgh bodysnatchers Burke and Hare

explanation.surface: A house that a grave robber occupies from time to time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' looks like a link word but gives TIMES, as in multiplication.
explanation.definitionFit: A timeshare is a holiday home owned jointly and used by each owner for set periods.

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for society

indicators.note: in places the line inside the fashionable word

parts.note: hep is old slang for trendy

explanation.surface: High society's trendy set dressed in drag.
explanation.definitionFit: Shlep is a Yiddish verb meaning to haul or carry something laboriously.

clue.text: It's expansive swapping cards — and silly

indicators.note: one card is exchanged for another, the ace for a nine

parts.note: Asia is the vast continent, a huge expanse

explanation.surface: A card game where trading hands is said to be broad-minded and foolish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swapping cards' replaces the final A (ace) of ASIA with NINE.
explanation.definitionFit: Asinine means foolish, literally like an ass.

clue.text: In which no liquid is measured out in kilos

indicators.note: measured out like portions, so the letters are dealt into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Describing a container that stays dry while weights are worked out in kilograms.
explanation.definitionFit: An oilskin is a waterproof garment, so no water gets in.

indicators.note: the two gos are placed in front of the a

parts.note: go is the green traffic light
go means energy or pep
a, as in so much a head, means per

explanation.surface: A vegetable that comes first in a lively competition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking precedence' reverses the clue's order: the go-go comes before the 'a'.
explanation.definitionFit: A green pepper is an unripe capsicum used as a vegetable.
